faq.a: No. You pay once. Pro is $19 for one server or $39 for all 49 paid servers. The key has no expiry date.

faq.q: What can I do without paying?
faq.a: Every server has a free tier with no key, no account and no expiry. Eight servers have no paid tier at all. The free tier isn't a trial: it doesn't end.

It depends on the server. Each server page has a Free and a Pro column taken from the server code. Examples: Invoice goes from 3 invoices a month with a footer line to unlimited, no branding, your logo and your own prefix. Time Tracker goes from a 7-day report window to full history.
With a card on Stripe Checkout. The Buy button opens a short confirmation page and then hands you to Stripe, with prices in US dollars.

faq.q: How do I get my key?
faq.a: The key shows on the success page right after payment. Reloading that page shows the same key. If you lose the tab, the recover page gets it back with your checkout session id. If you bought while connected through a hosted URL, that URL's token becomes Pro with nothing to paste.

faq.q: How do I turn Pro on?
faq.a: On a local server, set MCP_LICENSE_KEY to the key in the client config. On a hosted URL, put the key where the free token goes.

faq.q: Does the key send data anywhere?
faq.a: No. On the local install, the server checks the key signature on your machine and never calls a licence server. Your invoices, timesheets and files stay in your own data folder.
No. There's no sign-up. Stripe asks only for what a card payment needs.
Yes, within 14 days. Email support with your checkout details.

faq.q: Should I buy one server or the bundle?
faq.a: If you use one server, $19 is enough. If you use two or more, the bundle is cheaper: two singles cost $38, the bundle costs $39 and covers all 49. Many servers pass work to each other, for example time entries to invoices.

faq.q: The code is open source. Why pay?
faq.a: The free tier covers light use. Pro removes the limits, adds the client-ready outputs, and pays for the tests and the hosted endpoints.
